|description = This small bull sculpture was created by a House Cannith artificer. It can be useful to crafters.
|tips        = [[File:Mark of House Cannith store.png|right]]
* Purchased in stacks of 1 and can be stored in the [[Shared Crafting Storage]]
* [[BtA]] marks can be purchased in [[House Cannith]] from [[Visgard d'Cannith]], the [[House Cannith]] Vendor, and only after your character has earned 50 [[Favor#House Cannith|House Cannith Favor]]. Visgard d'Cannith (and the house Patron, Xaros d'Cannith) are in House Cannith on a floating platform that can only be reached by taking one of the moving lifts. (Lift stops are marked on the ground by yellow glowing runes.)
* Can sometimes be found in random chests.
* Used in special crafting recipes, these marks allow you to add an extra effect on a craftable item of minimum level 10 or higher.
* The description in the DDO Store (seen here) is out of date. The Mark no longer lowers the Minimum Level of an item.

}}
